evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive issued in plain declarative register — settled, confident authority without urgency or alarm; the calm confidence of a decision made.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic framing carries urgency-as-worry: the stakes of unrehearsed rollback framed as a loss, pressing the case with alarm rather than calm assertion.

mints.name: StakesAsAphoristicUrgency
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker pressing a case by crystallizing its stakes into a memorable maxim, rather than by calm assertion or direct command?
